items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Kurt put it out, and I add a viola duo, cello duo, and a violin duo to make a 60-minute record.

ctx.x: No, no, it did. Sorry. It did. Kurt put it out, and I add a viola duo, cello duo, and a violin duo to make a 60-minute record. That’s one of my best records.
Interesting. Here’s a big date with Hino for Flying Disc for Japan with a string section, and Marvin Stamm, all the studio heavies of the time.
